questions.question: 다음 중 짝지어진 단어의 관계가 어색한 것은?
questions.explanation: ④: '형편없는 : 아주 좋은' 반의어 관계 ≠ '그만두다 : 멈추다' 유의어 관계

options: He passed the ball to his __________.
The __________ for the contest is a book.
She receives lots of __________ from her fans.
He made a __________ in the test, so he felt sad.
questions.question:
다음 중 <보기>의 단어가 들어갈 수 없는 것은?
<보기> mistake, prize, situation, support, result
questions.explanation: ②: '그는 그의 팀원에게 공을 건네주었다.'에는 teammate(팀원), friends(친구)와 같은 단어가 들어간다.

options: You met a famous singer there. (의문문) → Did you meet a famous singer there?
Use this book next time. (부정 명령문) → Use not this book next time.
Sam reads a poem about hope. (과거시제) → Sam read a poem about hope.
Mom buys meat at the supermarket. (과거시제 부정문) → Mom not bought meat at the supermarket.
He didn't throw his trash in the trash can. (평서문) → He threw his trash in the trash can.
questions.question: 다음 중 주어진 문장을 괄호 안의 지시대로 알맞게 고치지 않은 것을 모두 고르면?
questions.explanation: ②: 부정명령문은 'Don't[Never]+동사원형'으로 쓰므로 Don't use this book next time으로 고쳐야 함. ④: 과거형 부정문은 'didn't[did not]+동사원형'으로 쓰므로 Mom didn't buy meat at the supermarket으로 고쳐야 함.

options: My camera isn't working at all. My mom works at a hospital.
Then, someone entered my room. She entered the writing contest.
He is working out hard these days. The test was hard, but I finished it.
Every summer, we hold a concert in the park. My school will hold a sports day next week.
She got five books and I got two. It's not fair. I bought some new novels at the book fair.
questions.question: 다음 밑줄 친 단어가 같은 의미로 쓰인 것은?
questions.explanation: ④: '매년 여름 공원에서 음악회를 개최한다'와 '내 학교는 다음 주에 운동회를 개최한다'의 hold 모두 '개최하다'라는 뜻의 동사로 쓰였다.

options: _________ not make noise in the library.
We _________ not have practice these days.
_________ you make your bed this morning?
She _________ not get enough sleep last night.
questions.question: 다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 나머지 셋과 다른 것 두 개를 모두 고르면?
questions.explanation: ④: 과거를 나타내는 부사구 this morning이 있으므로 과거시제가 되어야 하며, 일반동사 과거형 의문문은 'Did+주어+동사원형'으로 쓰므로 빈칸에는 Did가 들어가야 함. ⑤: 과거를 나타내는 부사구 last night가 있으므로 과거시제가 되어야 하며, 일반동사 과거형 부정문은 'didn't[did not]+동사원형'으로 쓰므로 빈칸에는 did가 들어가야 함.

questions.question:
다음 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞지 않은 것은?
G: What's up, Jamie? You look excited.
B: I got a ticket to the BM concert next month. I'm so excited.
G: _________________________ B: Thanks.
questions.explanation: ④: 신나 보이는 Jamie에게 BM 콘서트 표를 구했다는 좋은 일에 대해 함께 기뻐하는 내용의 말이 들어가야 하므로 '나는 BM을 안 좋아해.'는 알맞지 않음.

questions.question:
다음 <보기> 중, 대화의 빈칸 (A)에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것의 개수는?
W: You don't look well, Alex. What's wrong?
B: Sumin and I worked on a project for the science fair.
W: I know. It was about green energy. Right?
B: Yes. The fair was yesterday, and we didn't win any prizes.
W: Oh, (A)_______________________________
B: I'm so sad, Mom. We worked really hard for it.
W: Cheer up, Alex. You did your best.
B: Yeah, and we learned a lot about green energy, too. Thanks, Mom.

<보기> ⓐ well done! ⓑ that's too bad. ⓒ that's a shame. ⓓ don't mention it. ⓔ I'm sorry to hear that.
questions.explanation: 빈칸 (A)에 들어갈 수 있는 말은 ⓑ, ⓒ, ⓔ이다. Alex가 좋지 않은 상황을 얘기했으므로 이를 듣고 엄마의 반응으로는 위로의 말이 들어가야 한다.

questions.question:
위 대화를 읽고 다음 질문에 대한 답이 되도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 쓰시오.
Q. What was the topic of Alex's project for the science fair?
→ The topic of his project was _____________________. ※ 한 단어 또는 구로 답할 것

위 대화를 아래와 같이 요약할 때, 빈칸 ㉠, ㉡에 들어갈 말로 알맞게 연결된 것은?
Alex worked hard on a science fair project with Sumin, but didn't win a prize. Alex feels ㉠__________, and his mom encourages him with ㉡__________ words.
questions.explanation: Alex는 상을 받지 못해 속상해 하고 있으며, 엄마는 그에게 긍정적인 말로 격려하고 있다.

options: Every teammate is good at dancing.
Other teammates are angry with Suho's mistakes.
Yuna's team's practice is going well with support.
Yuna's team's future is dark because of Suho's mistakes.
Suho is cheering up other friends with nice words.
questions.question:
다음 글의 요지로 알맞은 것은?
Situation 2
D-14
Yuna and her teammates are practicing hard in the practice room.
Suho: I made a mistake again. I'm sorry.
Yuna: Cheer up! You can do it.
Minsu: Yes. Don't worry, Suho. We all make mistakes.
Bora: Come on. Let's do it one more time! We're almost there.
questions.explanation: 팀원들이 수호의 실수에도 서로를 격려하면서 열심히 연습하고 있으므로 '유나의 팀의 연습은 응원과 함께 잘 되어가고 있다'가 요지다.

questions.answer: (1) saw the sunrise at the East Sea (2) visited Naksansa Temple (3) didn't[did not] buy fried chicken
questions.question:
다음은 지난 주 보라의 속초 여행 계획과 실천 여부를 나타낸 표다. 이 표를 보고 대화의 빈칸을 완성하시오.

place | activity | O/X
Sokcho | see the sunrise over the East Sea | O
 | visit Naksansa Temple | O
 | buy fried chicken in Sokcho Central Market | X

A: How was your weekend?
B: Great! I went to Sokcho with my family.
A: Wow! What did you do there?
B: I (1)_____________________________________. It was very beautiful.
A: That sounds amazing. What else did you do there?
B: We (2)____________________________________. It was a peaceful place.

questions.question:
윗글의 괄호 (A), (B), (C)에서 흐름상 알맞은 말로 바르게 연결된 것은?

Situation 1
D-14
Yuna and her teammates are in the practice room, but no one looks happy.
Suho: We're making too many mistakes.
Bora: Yeah. We're hopeless.
Suho: By the way, where's Minsu?
Yuna: Well, he's sick. He texted me.
Bora: Really? I saw him last night, and he was (A)[ill / okay].

D-1
The contest is tomorrow, but Yuna and her teammates are not practicing.
Suho: I'm so tired.
Minsu: Me, too. We're not getting anywhere.
Bora: Yeah. We're just (B)[wasting / saving] our time.
Yuna: The dance contest was not a good idea.
Suho: I agree, but it's not your fault.
Yuna: Why don't we just (C)[go on / quit]?
After weeks of unhappy practices, they finally quit. They felt hopeless.
questions.explanation: (A) 보라가 민수가 어젯밤에 괜찮았다고 했으므로 okay가 적절. (B) 진전이 없으므로 시간을 낭비하는 중이라는 의미의 wasting이 적절. (C) 진행 중인 대회를 그만두자는 의미의 quit이 적절.

options: Tried Their Best, But Gave Up
questions.question: 윗글의 제목으로 알맞은 것은?
questions.explanation: 상황 1에서 팀원들이 연습 중에 누구도 행복해 보이지 않았으며 가망이 없다고 생각하고 결국 그만두기로 결정하므로 '춤 연습이 좌절로 끝나버렸다'가 제목으로 적절하다.

options: No one practiced happily in the practice room. (T)
Yuna's team thought in a negative way. (T)
On D-14, every teammate was in the practice room. (F)
Yuna's team made fewer mistakes on D-1. (T)
Yuna's team practiced for several month. (F)
questions.question: 윗글의 내용과 일치하면 T, 일치하지 않으면 F일 때, 알맞지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: ④: 유나의 팀은 대회 하루 전날 연습하고 있지 않았고, 민수가 자신들이 더 나아지지 않고 있다고 하고 있으므로 '더 적은 실수를 했다'는 일치하지 않는다.

options: When did the fair take place?
Why didn't Alex win any prizes?
What did Alex learn after the fair?
Who did Alex enter the science fair with?
How does Alex feel about the result of the fair?
questions.question:
다음 대화를 읽고 답할 수 없는 질문은?
W: You don't look well, Alex. What's wrong?
B: Sumin and I worked on a project for the science fair.
W: I know. It was about green energy. Right?
B: Yes. The fair was yesterday, and we didn't win any prizes.
W: Oh, I'm sorry to hear that.
B: I'm so sad, Mom. We worked really hard for it.
W: Cheer up, Alex. You did your best.
B: Yeah, and we learned a lot about green energy, too. Thanks, Mom.
questions.explanation: Alex가 상을 받지 못했다고 언급했지만 그 이유에 대해서는 언급되지 않았으므로 ② '왜 상을 타지 못했는가?'에는 답할 수 없다.

questions.question:
윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓕ 중, 어법상 어색한 것의 개수는?

Situation 2
D-14
Yuna and her teammates are practicing ⓐhard in the practice room.
Suho: I ⓑmade a mistake again. I'm sorry.
Yuna: Cheer up! You can do it.
Minsu: Yes. ⓒNot worry, Suho. We all make mistakes.
Bora: Come on. Let's do it one more time! We're almost there.

D-Day
The contest is over now. Yuna's team didn't win ⓓany prizes, but they all look happy.
Yuna: Good job! We made it.
Minsu: Yeah! We finished the dance without a big mistake. I feel ⓔgreatly!
Bora: We did our best, and I'm ⓕso proud of all of us.
Suho: Thank you for your support, everyone.
questions.explanation: 어법상 어색한 것은 총 2개다. ⓒ Not → Don't (명령문이므로), ⓔ greatly → great (감각동사 feel 뒤에는 형용사가 와야 함)

questions.question:
윗글의 내용을 바탕으로 유나와 인터뷰를 할 때, 빈칸에 들어갈 알맞은 말을 쓰시오.
You: Yuna, can you tell me about your team's practices?
Yuna: Sure. During the practices, we made mistakes, but we gave __________ to each other.
You: You helped each other! How was the contest?
Yuna: We didn't make a big __________ and finally finished the contest. We didn't __________ a prize, but we felt __________. ※ 각 빈칸에 한 단어씩 쓸 것

options: He was worried about his studies.
He was excited about her suggestion.
questions.question:
Every year, Yuna's school holds a dance contest. This year's contest is next month.
Yuna: Let's make a team and enter the contest.
Suho: Are you kidding? We're all terrible dancers.
Bora: I know, but I'm interested.
Minsu: Me, too. It'll be fun.
Yuna: Let's do it. Sounds good, Suho?
Suho: I guess so.

How did Suho react to Yuna's suggestion at first?
questions.explanation: 수호가 처음에 농담하지 말라고 하며 우리 모두 춤을 정말 못 춘다고 하며 다소 부정적 반응을 보였고, 마지막에 'I guess so'라고 하며 머뭇거리고 있으므로 ④ '그는 그녀의 제안에 대해 머뭇거렸다'가 적절하다.

questions.question:
윗글의 내용과 (A)~(C)가 일치하면 T, 일치하지 않으면 F를 쓸 때, 순서대로 연결된 것은?
(A) A dance contest takes place once a year at Yuna's school.
(B) Suho has confidence in his dancing skills.
(C) Two different stories about Yuna and her friends will follow.
questions.explanation: (A) 글에서 '매년' 춤 경연 대회가 열린다고 했으므로 T. (B) 수호는 우리 모두 춤을 못 춘다고 했으므로 자신감이 없음 (F). (C) 글의 끝에서 두 개의 다른 상황이 이어질 것이라고 했으므로 T.

questions.answer: We finished the dance without a big mistake.
questions.question:
윗글의 밑줄 친 (A)의 우리말을 주어진 <조건>에 알맞게 영작하시오.

Situation 2 [D-Day]
The contest is over now. Yuna's team didn't win any prizes, but they all look happy.
Yuna: Good job! We made it.
Minsu: Yeah! (A)우리는 큰 실수 없이 춤을 끝냈어. I feel great!
Bora: We did our best, and I'm so proud of all of us.
Suho: Thank you for your support, everyone.

<조건>
Ÿ finish, big, a, without, the dance를 사용할 것
Ÿ 필요시 단어를 추가하여 총 8단어로 쓸 것
Ÿ We로 시작할 것 ※ 완전한 문장으로 쓰시오.
acceptedAnswers: We finished the dance without a big mistake

options: their feedback on his dance moves
their understanding of his bad words
their encouragement for him during their practices
questions.question: Situation 2에서 Suho가 친구들에게 고마워한 것으로 알맞은 것은?
questions.explanation: 상황 2에서 수호가 대회가 끝난 후 친구들에게 응원해줘서 고맙다고 말했으므로 ⑤ '연습 중에 그에 대한 그들의 응원'이 적절하다.

questions.question:
윗글의 Situation 1과 Situation 2를 다음과 같이 정리할 때, 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓕ 중, 일치하지 않는 것의 개수는?

Situation 1 | Situation 2
과정
Minsu didn't come to the practice on D-14. ⓐThey made many mistakes and had a negative attitude about them. ⓑThey were unhappy and felt tired. | Everyone attended the practice on D-14. ⓓThey practiced hard and supported each other when they made mistakes. ⓔThey were very supportive and positive.
결과
ⓒThey felt helpless and finally gave up. | ⓕThey got a prize in the contest, so they felt proud of themselves.
questions.explanation: 일치하지 않는 것은 1개다. ⓕ '상을 탔기에 자랑스럽다'는 부정확하다. 상황 2에서 상을 타지 못했지만 최선을 다했기에 자랑스럽다고 했다.

questions.question:
윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ를 바르게 고치지 못한 것은?

Situation 1
D-14
Yuna and her teammates are in the practice room, but no one ⓐlook happy.
Suho: We're making too many ⓑmistake. Bora: Yeah. We're hopeless.
Suho: By the way, where's Minsu?
Yuna: Well, he's sick. He ⓒtexts me.
Bora: Really? I saw him last night, and he was all right.

D-1
The contest is tomorrow, but Yuna and her teammates ⓓnot are practicing.
Suho: I'm so tired.
Minsu: Me, ⓔneither. We're not getting anywhere.
Bora: Yeah. We're just wasting our time.
Yuna: The dance contest was not a good idea.
Suho: I agree, but it's not your fault.
Yuna: Why don't we just quit?
After weeks of unhappy practices, they finally quit. They felt hopeless.
questions.explanation: ⑤: ⓔ neither를 either로 고치는 것은 잘못됐다. 부정문 'I'm so tired'에 대해 '나도 그래'라고 동의할 때는 'Me, too'를 쓰나, Me 다음의 neither는 정확하지 않다. 'Me, too'가 맞다.

options: What did Minsu say in his text?
How did Bora feel on D-14?

How long did Yuna's team practice a day?

questions.question: 윗글의 제목으로 알맞은 것은?
questions.explanation: 글은 춤 경연 대회에 참가하기로 결성한 유나의 팀이 겪는 두 가지 상황을 보여준다. 상황 1에서는 부정적 태도로 일관하여 결국 포기했고, 상황 2에서는 긍정적 마음으로 최선을 다해 의미 있는 결과를 얻었으므로 ③ '다른 관점이 다른 결과를 이끈다'가 제목으로 적절하다.
